intro: Sri Lankan culture is shaped by Buddhism, Hindu and Muslim traditions, and colonial influences.

chapters.title: Festivals
text: The Esala Perahera in Kandy parades decorated elephants to honour the Buddha's Tooth Relic. Sinhala and Tamil New Year is celebrated in April.

chapters.title: Food
text: Rice and curry, hoppers (bowl-shaped pancakes) and kottu roti are everyday food, with plenty of coconut and spice.
